facts.fact: The FIG paper by NUST authors says the Namibia Communal Land Administration System has registered over 193,000 communal land rights, all mapped and digitised, about 79% of the estimated total.
The paper says the Digital Cadastral Information System's LIS crashed the previous year and is under further development, with the planned spatially enabled website not yet materialised.

systems.owner: Ministry of Agriculture, Water and Land Reform
